'''Otu Del's Custom Pods and Swoops''' was a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] shop located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The proprietor of the swoop shop was an individual named [[Otu Del]]. The shop catered to [[Swooper/Legends|swoop racers]] who looked to perform the popular move "[[Threading the needle|threading the Needle]]" in [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]].<ref name="Edge" />

==Behind the scenes==
Otu Del's Custom Pods and Swoops was mentioned in [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]], a [[2013]] rulebook for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Edge" />
